## Why This Is Asked

Assess practical ability to embed security gates into CI/CD and IaC pipelines, catching misconfigurations before deployment.

## Key Concepts

- CloudFormation linting (cfn-lint) and IaC policy checks
- AWS Config rules: s3-bucket-public-read-prohibited, s3-bucket-public-write-prohibited, cloudtrail-enabled, tls-feature-enabled on API Gateway
- IAM permissions boundaries and least privilege
- Security Hub integration for centralized findings

## Code Example

```javascript
// Pseudo gate logic for pre-deploy checks

  throw new Error('Public S3 buckets are not allowed in this deployment');
}
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you extend to multi-account deployments?
- How would you verify the gate itself is resilient to bypass attempts?
